help.title: Help
help.contact: Can't find the answer? Write to {{email}} or to the trainer via Team.

q.absence: How do I report an absence?
q.video: Where do I find choreography videos?
q.write: Who do I write to – and where?
q.child: Can my child get their own login?

a.absence: Tap the training under Home → Your week (or in Calendar) and choose “Report absence”. Pick a reason, add a note if you like, and the trainer is told right away.
a.pay: Teams, punch cards and the shop are paid with Vipps MobilePay to the studio's number with the reference the app shows. Open Payments and punch cards in the menu behind your picture and tap “Pay” – on a phone MobilePay opens directly. Once the school has seen the payment you get a receipt by e-mail.
a.video: Under Team → Choreography. On mini and kids teams parents see the videos; on junior and adult teams they are for the dancers only.
a.write: Messages from the school are under Home. Under Team you find the trainer's messages and “Write to the trainer”. Social is the team's own feed.
a.child: Yes, from age 13. Open My children in the menu behind your picture and tap “Grant login” – the child signs in with their own e-mail and sees only their own team. Under 13 you share your profile.
